title: Smooth curve through ordered 3D points — spline_path
text: Two curves available, differ way matters: "catmull-rom" (default) **interpolates**: curve passes     every input point, point's tangent derived     two neighbours.  want input points     positions curve hit (measured digitized data). "bspline" **approximates**: points act control cage     curve stays inside, irons noise instead reproducing     , curve \(C^2\) continuous everywhere.  generally     pass input points. Catmull-Rom curve, alpha selects parameterization knob matters real data: 0.5 (default) — *centripetal*.  Knot intervals grow     square root chord length, prevents cusps, loops     self-intersections uniform curve produces spacing     input points uneven (long segment followed short one,     norm measured data). 1 — chord length: still free cusps, can overshoot . 0 — uniform: textbook curve, exact evenly spaced points     misbehaving everything else.
